newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool - Higher prices hard to pass on.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool - Higher prices hard to pass on.

text.p: Prices were being kept as competitive as possible in a Bradford wool market where almost everyone agreed that passing on higher prices was proving very difficult indeed.
Relatively small sectors of the market that are interested in finer merinos were not accepting the rise in values for fine merino wool.
Middle micron categories have not moved up significantly, if at all, with sterling's strength tending to offset much smaller price rises than apply to finer merinos.
Coarser crossbreds remain weak and there seemed to be no question of anticipating higher prices for british wool this week.

Markets participants tended to think that finer merinos might rise further before the end of the season but that there may be no follow through next season, so the market was not being carried away by a rise still concentrated in one specialized sector.
